newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Great Central sees 1996/97 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Great Central sees 1996/97 profits up.

text.p: Major gold miner Great Central Mines NL said on Wednesday it expected to achieve pre-tax and pre-abnormals profit growth of more than 15 percent for the year ended June 30, 1997.

"The company anticipates that its operating profit before income tax and abnormal items will, in the current year, be greater than 15 percent over the corresponding period last year," managing director Joseph Gutnick said in a statement.
The company made operating profits totalling A$46.13 million for the year to June 30, 1996.
Gutnick also said Great Central was not expected to record a material abnormal or extraordinary profit or loss for the fiscal year.
Great Central made the statement in response to an Australian Stock Exchange query of its share price which has slipped about 20 percent since the beginning of March.
At 0000 GMT (11.00 a.m.) Great Central shares were trading two cents lower at A$2.68.
